review_description: The sales quoting process was efficient and friendly. Great follow up and responsiveness. The installation team were great, friendly, efficient and clean. All of the end to end was completed and working.

Sales person was polite and knowledgeable. Explained pros and cons of the various systems. The whole process  was easy. Installers were polite, efficient and tidy. The grid connection went ahead smoothly. All in all, happy to pay extra for quality and professionalism.

The sales person explained everything thoroughly, provided details of Solaharts experience and made the overall process very easy. With so many scams around we were reluctant to lol at getting solar. They did an awesome job and I would recommend to others.
From the initital consultation and the actual installation all proceeded very well.
Very good installers, tidy, careful and good manners, good clean up after the work completed.

Very good tradesmen, very quick install, little interruption to daily life, explained the type of panels and their connection.Coupled with a SOLAHART hot water replacement which died the day of the quote! Discount for returning customer, temp hot water till install completed. Couldn't be happier.Installed 0n 25/7 - AGL can't connect their SMART meter till 13/9
Good job. Numerous delays due to wet weather. The guys kept me in the loop of when they would be back, and eventually got the install complete. All good.

Everything went very smooth, knowledgeable sales team, able to answer all our enquiries, very quick and easy installation. Because they have been around for 70 years, know a lot about solar and good after sales service. They will be around if anything goes wrong over the next few years

After meeting with four other providers, we chose Solahart because of the Brand and the knowledge of the sales person along with his frank and open attitude which was a change from his predecessors. Also he provided us with a detailed quotation which included three different options for us to choose.The installation of the solar panels and inverter was handled by a professional team who knew exactly what to do. The team of four were great people and a pleasure to have in our home.The installation of the hot water system (Solahart Powerstore 315ESX with Energy Management kit) was handled by a different team, who were as equally professional as the solar panel/ inverter team.The IT support has been great which means I can access in real time information on the status of our solar panels, inverted and hot water system.
Everything went so smoothly from quote to installation. Super happy to have no more power bills.

Great experience overall with Solarhart. The salesperson came out and explained the whole process from start to finish. Took the time to explain how solar worked. Price was on par with other quotes. Solarhart installation was seamless. Great team. Nil issues

Everything went well, the installers were very quick, well mannered and professional. They tidied up everything and explained what I needed to know. I needed a new meter and that was organised for me and has now been done. All I need now is for the rain to stop. 25yr warranty on the panels and 10ths on the inverter. Couldn’t be happier.
